// Generated by @zakkster/lite-scrollforge - toRig
// Do not edit by hand. Regenerate from the source storyboard.
// Rig supports translateX, translateY, scale, rotate only --
// other properties are dropped with a comment per track.

import { ScrollEngine, DOMScroller } from '@zakkster/lite-scroll-rig-pro';
import { KeyframePool } from '@zakkster/lite-keyframe';

export function attachScrollRig(container) {
    // Track 0 (.parallax): skipped -- scroll-timeline is not supported by the rig.

    const selectors = [
    ];
    const elements = selectors.map(function (s) { return document.querySelector(s); });
    const pool = new KeyframePool(elements.length * 4, 8);

    const engine = new ScrollEngine(container || document.body);
    const scroller = new DOMScroller(elements, pool, { engine: engine });

    return function detach() {
        if (scroller && typeof scroller.dispose === "function") scroller.dispose();
        if (engine   && typeof engine.dispose   === "function") engine.dispose();
    };
}
